mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 34 degrees and overcast by the Verona Area High School, with a waning gibbous moon in the sky.

The 2027 Spring Election cycle is officially underway in Verona. All four Aldermanic Districts have seats on the ballot, and candidate packets are now available at the City Clerk's office on Lincoln Street. Please note that all paperwork must be submitted by 5:00 p.m. on January 5, 2027.

There is plenty to do in town, starting today with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and a 50-year craft brewing celebration at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out live music at Paddy Mac's or head over to the Crafty Fair at ART House 360.

In a noteworthy incident from November 6, Verona Police responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where they found a driver unresponsive in their vehicle. The individual was subsequently arrested for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Snickers Swirl. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and enjoy a scoop.
